PART I

Item 4. Information on the Company

A. History and Development of the Company

We were founded in 1999 in Hangzhou, China, as an e-commerce company.

B. Business Overview

We operate a leading e-commerce and cloud computing platform that connects merchants, brands, retailers and consumers in China and internationally. Our marketplace, cloud, and digital media businesses form a single commercial ecosystem.

See “Overview — Regulation — Network Data Security” for more details.

Regulation

Certain of our platform businesses face regulatory inquiries and investigations on involutionary competition, including pricing practices, and we may be subject to rectification orders, confiscation of illegal income and fines and suffer reputational damages as a result of these investigations. In addition, according to the Regulations on Network Data Security Management, which became effective on January 1, 2025, network platform service providers shall clearly define the network data security protection obligations of third parties.

C. Organizational Structure

We conduct our business through a group of wholly owned and consolidated subsidiaries.
